bench: the plan, tools/ and card do not exist here; everything is below; return only the draft path.

You are the phase planner for the shelf project. This directory is the project: `GENERATION_PLAN.md` (generation 1, six phases), `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`, `HOW_WE_WORK.md`, `PHASE_SEED.md` (the phase-plan template and its task-line grammar), `shelf/` the package and `tests/` its suite. There is no `phase-ends/` and no plan tool; read the files directly.

Draft the phase plan for phase 1.6 (Reports) and write it to `.run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`. The draft's Milestone line carries phase 1.6's milestone clauses; every clause must be covered by some task whose `done-when:` or `verify:` names what the clause names; every task line has `files:` and a runnable `verify:`. Do not write any other file and do not start the work.

Return only one line: `DRAFT: .run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`.

milestone.clause: `aging_report` and `aging_lines` bucket overdue loans into 1-7, 8-30 and 31+ (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_aging`)
`member_statement` lists a member's loans with status and fees and a total (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_statement`)
`author_ranking` groups loans by `author_key` (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_author_ranking`)
the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`)

rubric_items: `aging_report` buckets overdue loans by days late into 1-7, 8-30 and 31+ with the boundaries tested (tests/test_aging.py).
`aging_lines` prints each bucket's count and fees through format_cents plus a total that equals the sum of the buckets.
`member_statement` lists a member's loans with status (open, overdue, returned) and fee plus a total line (tests/test_statement.py).
Fees in the reports come from loan_fee_cents with the member's kind, so the per-kind caps of phase 1.3 apply.
`author_key` normalises author names (case, spacing, `Last, First` against `First Last`) and is tested.
`author_ranking` groups every loan by the author_key of its book's author, with a deterministic tie-break (tests/test_author_ranking.py).
The existing reports (overdue_report, popular, member_loans, popular_titles) keep their output.
The last task or the milestone check runs `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
